build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a dynamic ball and static obstacle pattern
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with a specified scale
create_static_balls: create multiple static ball obstacles arranged in a spiral pattern below the dynamic ball
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the dynamic ball touching the bottom wall
generate_spiral_pattern: generate a spiral pattern of static balls using random walk with angle perturbations
